_comment: Copy this file to config.json (or point ARTEX_CONFIG at another path). It contains only the database and skill_dir settings. LLM and other configuration live in environment variables or in-app settings, not here.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. Precedence: environment variable ARTEX_PG_DSN > this file's database block. Choose one of two forms: (A) fill in the individual fields below, or (B) put a complete connection string in database.dsn only.
_comment_database_dsn: Form (B): delete the database block above and use a complete DSN instead. When dsn is non-empty, the individual fields are ignored.
_comment_skill_dir: Skills root directory (each subdirectory is one skill and contains SKILL.md). Precedence: environment variable ARTEX_SKILL_DIR > this field > default (skills/ next to the executable). Leave it empty or remove the field to use the default. Relative paths resolve against the current working directory.
_comment_language: Default user-facing output language (one of en, ko, zh, es, ja). Agent-generated reports, summaries, chat replies, and backend messages follow this language. Precedence: environment variable ARTEX_LANG > this field > default (en). At runtime the display language chosen in Settings overrides this default. Leave it empty or remove the field to use the default (en).
